excerpts.author: yperbasis
excerpts.content: Which version of EIP-4788 is devnet-8 supposed to have: A) the currently published one eip-4788.md 3ca51a1, B) with PR 7431 (set nonce to nonzero), or C) with PR 7456 (no precompile) but with `BEACON_ROOTS_ADDRESS=0xB` ?

excerpts.author: __flcl
excerpts.content:
`C` I guess
There is a contract predeployed to 0xb you are free to call within system tx, or you can set storage directly. The result should be the same
